==Naming issue==
Could I have a few people confirm this in their own copies of the book? In {{Wh|14}}, there is a ''sul'dam'' that holds [[Lidya]]'s ''a'dam''. In one version that I have seen, it says that the woman is named '''Ianelle''', but in another, her name is '''Lanelle'''. Lanelle also shows up in {{Tgs}}. The paperback that I have (with the name Ianelle) was printed in 2002. The ISBN is 0-812-57558-X. Several searches bring up both of them in ''Winter's Heart''. Right now we have both pages created, this one for the character in ''Winter's Heart'' and [[Lanelle]] for the character in ''The Gathering Storm''. To me, it would seem, they are supposed to be the same person. They are both ''sul'dam'', both from Seanchan, both, it would stand to reason, in the service of Tuon. I will try and get a message to Brandon Sanderson on Facebook or through some other means and see what they say.
